title: Meridian S01 Exterior Complete
description: The M07.4 master models the 900 m Meridian observatory, from its twin telescope trusses to its rotating habitat, three radiator fins and aft drive.
detail: Port and starboard optical assemblies sit on separate trusses with service harnesses, mechanical fittings and thermal blankets.
A fixed-hull pressure shell carries the exterior circular hatch and the inner crew bypass hatch.
MeridianAirlockRefit(60 0 0) selects a 60-second habitat rotation period and closes both controlled hatches at time zero.
